note: Single-column body page, SUMMARY then EXERCISES. 24 elements. COLUMN/MEASURE: one full column only, x0=0.097 to x1=0.687 of page width - the printed measure is narrow and the OUTER (right) margin is 0.313 of the page, so a renderer must not set this text to the full sheet width. body_text_size_px=21.0 measured cap-to-baseline on the 'T' of 'The' in the first SUMMARY line (y 367-387 px). size_pt values assume the page is a 200 dpi render of a 612x784 pt sheet (2.778 px/pt): body cap 21 px is about 10.8 pt type, the two cyan small-cap headings about 12.9 pt. EXERCISE INDENTS (the point of this page): the list is set with a hanging indent - the numerals sit in a column whose left edge is x=181 px (x=170 for the two-digit '10.') and whose periods align at x=201, while all question TEXT and all turnover lines start at x=232-234 px. So each question element's `indent` (0.0094, or 0.0029 for Q10) is the inset of its NUMERAL from the column's left edge, and the question's own text hangs 0.0394 in. `indent` is reported throughout as the INSET of the element's left edge from the column left edge (x=165 px), as a fraction of page width, not as an absolute x. The three indented sub-part groups are reported as their own elements because their indent and (for Q5) their face differ from the question line: Q5's two italic Mangifera lines (indent 0.0400, serif-italic), Q7's three option lines '(a)(b)(c)' with arrows (indent 0.0406, one element, not three - without the indent they read as three more questions), and Q9's single '(i)-(v)' line (indent 0.0406). All three align with the question TEXT column, not deeper than it. SPACING: the whole page is set on one uniform 40 px (0.0184 of page height) baseline grid - paragraph lines, question lines and sub-part lines alike. There is NO extra space between consecutive exercise questions; the space_before values of 0.0060-0.0096 are just that single line gap, and they vary only because the ink bbox of a line depends on whether it happens to carry ascenders or descenders. The only real spacing decisions on the page are space_before 0.0395 above the SUMMARY heading, 0.0230 between a heading and the text under it (0.0174 under EXERCISES), and 0.0317 between the last line and the footer band. BANDS: the page header is two stacked bands, both reported as page_header_band - a pale green #e0ebb6 field y 0-0.0817 and a grey #d1d2d4 strip y 0.0822-0.0950 that carries the running header. The page number sits in a white rounded tab (x 0.814-0.870, y 0.066-0.095) notched into both bands; its bbox is the tab, the '9' glyph itself is at x 1406-1424 px. The foot of the page is a 92 px THICK green #cadf7f band, not a thin rule - footer_rule is the nearest allowed role. The '2024-25' edition line sitting on that band is a running FOOTER; the role list has no footer-text value so it is reported as running_header - a consumer should not treat it as a second page header. BLOCK MATCHING: A2 block 4 is the ENTIRE ten-question list. It is split here into 13 layout elements (Q1-Q10 plus the three sub-part groups). n=4 is carried only on the Q1 element so the match is recorded once; the other twelve are n=null and are part of block 4, NOT separate blocks - do not render block 4's text thirteen times. WATERMARK: the last two decorative_image elements are a digital-edition overlay, not printed furniture - a pale yellow disc #fffce4 behind the summary and a grey #e8e8e8 diagonal 'NCERT / not to be republished' legend. The diagonal one's bbox is approximate (+/- about 15 px) because it crosses the body text and cannot be segmented cleanly from it; both can be dropped. TEXT BLOCK AND FILL: text_block is measured from the printed content - top of the SUMMARY heading (y 293 px) to the baseline of the last exercise line (y 2017 px). The page is set completely full on that frame, so fill=1.0; the last line clears the footer band by only 69 px. No figure, table, equation, box or marginal note appears on this page, and nothing was left out of `elements`.
